detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Return to Tahnra in Hold the Line, a new expansion built around large-scale defensive battles, aggressive counterattacks, and building an army capable of surviving increasingly overwhelming odds.

Fight through 15 brand new battlefield chapters in a standalone new game mode! Each battle places your army under mounting pressure as enemy forces attack from multiple vectors. But surviving is only half the battle. Push beyond your defenses to capture and hold valuable positions, secure additional gold and resources, and take greater risks for greater rewards.

Between chapters, recruit new troops, improve your Squads and army, and earn powerful army-wide bonuses. As the campaign escalates, so too will the strength, composition, and scale of the forces arrayed against you.

A NEW WAY TO PLAY

Victory Points are everything. The longer you hold strongpoints and key objectives, the more Victory Points you accumulate. The enemy will be constantly working to recapture those strongpoints from you!

DEFEND — OR COUNTERATTACK

Hold fortified positions, control strategic nodes, protect critical objectives, and endure increasingly dangerous enemy assaults. Defensive play will keep you alive, but commanders willing to leave the safety of their walls can seize additional territory and resources to strengthen their army for the battles ahead.

BUILD AN ARMY FOR THE LONG WAR

Use the gold and resources earned during battle to recruit troops, expand and improve your Squads, and prepare for progressively more difficult chapters. Your performance also unlocks new army-wide bonuses between battles, allowing your force to develop differently over the course of each campaign.

CALL UP THE HEROES OF SYMPHONY OF WAR

Recruit familiar story characters from Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga, bringing some of Tahnra's most accomplished warriors back into battle.

NEW WAYS TO BUILD YOUR SQUADS

Hold the Line adds:

  • 15 epic new defense-focused chapters in a new game mode

  • 5 new unit classes: The Lancer, Ninja, Mystic Knight, Bard, and General

  • 5 New artifacts

  • 4 New traits

  • (All of the new classes, artifacts, and traits will also be available for the base game and Legends content!)

  • New strategic objectives centered around defense, node control, expansion, and high-risk counterattacks

  • New army-wide bonuses earned between chapters
